blueprints.name: Yellow transport workshop · from raw materials
blueprints.author: Factorio Command Center
setupNotes: Connect external electricity to the big electric pole marked P. Medium electric poles power the machines and inserters.

Research Logistics, Circuit network, Fast inserter, Automation 2, Advanced material processing, Electric Energy Distribution 1. Circuit network is required for production: keep the green wires, belt reader and item limits intact.
Feed only Iron ore, Copper ore, Coal at the labeled left-side ports. All smelting and intermediate products are made inside. No robots required.

Each input has an item/fluid display directly above its belt or pipe. Connect from the left; both belt lanes take the shown material. Press Alt to see the labels. Display panels need Circuit network research: leave their ghosts unbuilt until then; production works without the signs.
Uses assembling machine 2, steel furnaces, yellow circulating belts and filtered fast inserters.
The circulating belt shares ingredients between machines. 4 iron furnaces supply the chain. The controls limit circulating stock and reserve ingredients for other recipes.
Collect the three transport products from their separate numbered wooden chests. Each chest holds one stack. Empty it or connect an output belt to continue making that item.
Yellow belts also feed underground belts and splitters internally. The belt output chest fills once the circulating supply has a reserve.
changes: Shared smelting and a controlled circulating belt feed all three transport outputs.
Every intermediate is made inside from raw resources.
